name: Fish ID
subtitle: Your offline fish field guide
description:
Photograph a fish from the side or choose a picture from your library. Fish ID analyzes the image on your device. Its iNaturalist model can suggest 17 fish species, including largemouth bass, northern pike, rainbow trout and the Moorish idol. Check the visible markings before confirming a name. When the image gives no reliable match, choose a species yourself.

Explore 22 illustrated profiles. Learn to recognize a pumpkinseed by its gill flap, a channel catfish by its forked tail and a yellow perch by its dark bars. Compare any two species by their markings, typical length and habitat. Search by common or scientific name and keep favorites for your next trip.

Your private notebook stores photos, dates and field notes on this device. Revisit an observation, edit its note or save a field card to Photos. Weekly activity, a seasonal challenge and Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets keep your recent finds close.

The model, guide and sample rainbow trout photograph are included, ready to use offline. The dated fishing reference covers Florida freshwater rules. Check the current rules for the water you visit.
release_notes: Discover 22 illustrated fish profiles and an offline iNaturalist model covering 17 species. Compare lookalikes and explore habitat, range and identifying marks.
promotional_text: Identify fish on your device, compare 22 illustrated profiles and keep a photo notebook. Try the included rainbow trout photograph straight away.
review_notes: Open Identify and tap Try a sample photo. The included USFWS rainbow trout is processed on device and does not affect the notebook or statistics. Select a suggestion to inspect its field marks. On a personal photograph, confirm a species to save the observation. The Field guide contains 22 profiles and a species comparison. Check the identification scope on a profile. Camera, photo export and notifications are optional. External references open in the browser.
